lcc_original: 你要用松柏木造一隻樓船：你造那樓船、要有許多艙窩，船內外要糊上松香【3】。
notes: LCC uses 松柏 (pine-cypress) where UNV has 歌斐 for WH01613 (gopher wood); SN attached to 松柏 accordingly.

Second clause restructured: UNV '分一間一間<WH07064>地造{<WAH0853>}{<WH08392>}' becomes '你造那樓船、要有許多艙窩'. SNs redistributed: 造<WH06213><WTH8799>, 那<WAH0853> for formerly implicit אֵת, 樓船<WH08392> for formerly implicit תֵּבָה, 艙窩<WH07064> for compartments (קִנִּים).
LCC inserts 船 (ship) before 內外 as contextual qualifier; 船 left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent.
Second 你 in LCC ('你造那樓船') is a Chinese stylistic addition; Hebrew embeds the subject in verb conjugation תַּעֲשֶׂה, so no <WAH09001> applied.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit before 松香: LCC has no explicit pronominal object for אֹתָהּ in the pitch-covering clause.
